lines.t: [A haunting, mid-tempo worship song]
In the quiet places where the hungry come,
A voice calls out that only the listening hear.
Hands reach up through dust and waiting years,
And find themselves already held, already known.
But the ones who turn their faces to the wind
Find the air grow thin and the ground grow hard.
What once felt close now echoes far away—
A silence deeper than any spoken word.
I am the One whose purpose never bends,
Written before the first light illuminated the dark.
What I have claimed cannot be pulled apart;
The story ends the way it first began.
My own are marked with a name only I speak,
And they will find the door already open.
Some build walls of words and careful deeds,
Pretending distance is the safer path.
Yet every step away reveals the heart—
And leaves them walking where the rivers dried.
Still others run with nothing left to prove,
From far-off hills or just across the room.
They are pulled in faster than the eye can track,
Because the One who calls already knew their names.
I am the One whose purpose never bends,
Written before the first light touched the dark.
What I have claimed cannot be pulled apart;
The story ends the way it first began.
My own are marked with a name only I speak,
And they will find the door already open.
Stop measuring by the eyes that only see the surface.
Learn the deeper measure—love that knows the end from the start.
The ones joined to Me will walk straight through,
While the rest keep circling the same dry ground.
I am the One whose purpose never bends…
Before the world, the choice was already made.
My beloved have always belonged to Me—
And nothing now can change what was decided then.
